rule: experiments/correction-round/README.md §4, frozen 2026-09-18; run under the 2026-09-20 declaration
compiler_flags_note: ADR-0063. The gate here asks 'does this satisfy a stricter compiler', not 'does this preserve what the project's own compiler says'. No figure here may share a table cell with one taken under the project's own configuration.

task_set.selection: first 30 by path from a 144-file pool; pool = src, non-test, 1-3 errors under the flag, inside the 22,674-char rewrite ceiling, excluding class-hierarchy codes TS2417/TS2418

pass1.note: This pass IS §4.0.4's uncorrected control, on the same task set by construction.

T_c_measured_from: the corrector's own subagent transcript, scripts/planner-tokens.mjs --agent
T_e_source: Phase 11 C3 control, tokens/task, priced at Sonnet per §4.1
S_be_note: A range, not a point: §4.1 gives T_e as a single token count and the input/output split of Phase 11's C3 total is not recorded. The bounds are all-input and all-output at Sonnet rates.
verdict_rule: §4.2: S_c < S_be. Here S_c = 0 and S_be > 0 under every assumption in the range, so the kill switch of ADR-0044 §4 rule 2 fires unambiguously.

quality_veto.reason: §4.3 compares A_c against A_u. There are zero corrected survivors, so A_c is undefined, and A_u has n = 1. The veto cannot be measured and does not need to be — §4.2 already produced OFF, and the veto can only make a verdict stricter.

adr_0069_exposure.note: Recorded from the verdict's own baseline_captured_at/verified_at, landed the same day. 15 verdicts were taken against a baseline from the previous calendar day, and none reached the suite — the only stage a date-dependent test can affect. So ADR-0069 has no purchase on this result, stated from the field rather than inferred.

adr_0066_exposure.note: Swap fell over the run. Not a contended machine.

confounds: ADR-0071: 12 of the 29 are unsatisfiable by construction — they fail because a test file the plan may not list gains an error when the task's file changes type. A correction cannot rescue them and they are NOT excluded, because §4.0.4 forbids changing the set after seeing failures.

ADR-0072: those same 12 carried a brief whose compiler excerpt was the project's alphabetically-first 2 KB and named neither the task's file nor the file that gained an error. Their corrections were written from a degraded brief, so their contribution to S_c is a floor rather than a measurement of the mechanism working.
§4.5: the task set was chosen to contain failures, so n2 > 0 is an artefact of selection and this phase may not claim a rate at which real work reaches the correction round.
ADR-0063 adds a second selection: the strictness setting was chosen too. A different flag would give a different task set.

the_clean_subset.why_clean: Their briefs are not affected by ADR-0072 — each names the file and the rule broken — and they are not unsatisfiable: the worker simply did not attempt the edit.
the_clean_subset.result: 0 survived. 16 of 17 returned the file byte-identical AGAIN, after a specific note saying that returning it unchanged was the failure.
the_clean_subset.reading: This is a finding about the worker rather than about the correction round. On this shape a 7B does not act on an instruction it has already been given twice.
